stem: Which of the following occurred between 1865 and 1900 as a result of the rapid industrialization of the United States?

options.label: F
options.text: Social and economic class divisions began to disappear.

options.label: G
options.text: Concerns about air pollution led to stricter environmental regulations.

options.label: H
options.text: Union membership increased as workers sought better pay and conditions.

options.label: J
options.text: Factory owners introduced wage-equity policies for women in the workplace.
